item.title: WATCH: Dramatic video shows the moment a U.S. fighter jet narrowly dodges an Iranian missile
item.summary: Dramatic video shows the moment a missile came dangerously close to shooting down a F-18 fighter jet over Iran. It comes as Israel announced it killed Iran's navy chief.

item.title: WATCH: Trump extends deadline second time for Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: For the second time this week, President Trump extended an ultimatum for Iran to completely open the Strait of Hormuz to international shipping traffic, saying peace talks "are going very well."

item.title: LIVE: ABC News Live
item.summary: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: WATCH: Delivery robots slam into Chicago bus shelters, cause damage
item.summary: Two delivery robots are now being blamed for separate incidents which damaged city property. WLS-TV's Karen Jordan reports.

item.title: WATCH: Melania Trump showcases robot guest at WH summit
item.summary: A walking, talking humanoid robot strolled side-by-side with first lady Melania Trump at the White House for the second day of her international technology summit.

item.title: WATCH: 109-year-old Orioles fan throws first pitch on Opening Day
item.summary: 109-year-old Arthur Green, a World War II and Korean War veteran, threw out the ceremonial first pitch for the Baltimore Orioles on Opening Day.

item.title: WATCH: Airport crisis worsens as talks hit snag
item.summary: More than 40 days into the partial government shutdown, wait times at airport security checkpoints nationwide have reached historic levels.

item.title: Trump says he'll sign order directing DHS to pay TSA workers as shutdown drags on
item.summary: Trump he'll sign an executive order instructing DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin to pay TSA workers immediately, calling the ongoing DHS shutdown an "Emergency Situation."

item.title: Gilgo Beach suspect Rex Heuermann could change his plea to guilty: Sources
item.summary: The Suffolk County district attorney's office, which charged Heuermann in the deaths of seven women, declined to comment.

item.title: WATCH: Gender pay gap widens for 2nd year in a row
item.summary: Data from the U.S. Census Bureau shows that women working full-time, year-round jobs still earn less than men.
